data_use.enforcement_scope: This dedicated harness exposes only one frozen descriptive matrix and no optimizer/training path. The existing generic authority can admit validation-grade for an optimizer validation role; the role declaration is not a platform-wide access-control guarantee or blind holdout. Such optimizer use of these reserved inputs is not authorized by this contract.
data_use.independence_units: 8 source speakers / 32 original utterances / 4 disjoint speaker pairs; profile and scene outputs are correlated repeats, not 128 independent samples
data_use.new_use_authorized_only_by_this_study: fixed 128-call descriptive measurement; source preparation receipt remains unchanged
data_use.sealed_data_definition: Exact input-file hashes are frozen before processing; this is not blind access control, an unseen holdout, or a universal independence claim.

measurement.aggregation: retain every case and null; separate scene/profile; per-speaker equal weight summaries over its four originals; report source/pair counts; no confidence or independence claim from repeated views
measurement.doubletalk_projection_limit: known-interference projection attenuation is descriptive and is not pure far-end ERLE
measurement.doubletalk_scope: Whole-original-near preservation in scenes containing doubletalk; structural overlap is partial (reported per case), not continuous full-utterance doubletalk pressure.
measurement.near_identity_rule: raw near-only equals clean reference: preserve true identity and original finite epsilon-regularized canonical value; do not invent zero baseline or erase negative deltas
measurement.nonfinite: nonfinite numbers fail integrity; legitimate null remains null
measurement.phase_limit: fixed API-declared block latency compensation does not calibrate frequency-dependent HPF/BF phase or physical propagation delay
measurement.primary_mask_rule: near_mask=[24000,24000+near_native_frames); common lo=max(mask_lo, all -delay); hi=min(mask_hi, every signal_length-delay); require entire native near support survives
measurement.primary_scope: same complete original-near source interval, intersected with valid raw/CALL/ASSISTANT sample ranges under fixed declared delays
measurement.secondary: retain unchanged dualmic_profile_support.validation_semantics full-case canonical results including existing bounded target-correlation alignment +/-3ms and quality projections
measurement.secondary_diagnostic_lag_search: Unchanged canonical render/interference max_abs_corr diagnostics also search +/-100ms; these diagnostics never select primary delays or sources.

secondary_native_transport.guard_rule: Every score holds the original native lock, checks exact binder-owned CDLL/function/state identity and source/loader/binary hashes before and after original exact_score; missing or changed state fails without compilation.
secondary_native_transport.loading_rule: Bind only the retained verified bundle, on a fresh clean Python host; reject LD_PRELOAD/LD_AUDIT/LD_LIBRARY_PATH pollution and any prior automatic-compiler state.
secondary_native_transport.math_unchanged: Original C integer-lag search and original exact_score final Python normalized_corr(stride=4), including native/canonical tolerance 1e-10, remain unchanged.
secondary_native_transport.readback_rule: Independent reader may execute the same already-compiled native mathematical score helper; it invokes zero SDK audio processors, zero decoders and zero C/C++ compilers.

measurement.secondary_target_lag_search: existing canonical method only, explicitly reported; never used to choose primary delay, source, profile or candidate
measurement.zero_energy: preserve canonical null and explicit counts; no replacement or score-driven omission

processor.default_tuning: read hash-bound engineering default_tuning for both profiles; implicit_default_equals_call must be true
processor.engineering_rule: synthetic engineering must verify every trace reports 10ms; no impulse-peak or target-lag fitting
processor.revision_rule: bundle.code_revision equals the actual publicly frozen harness revision; distinct source preparation revision remains a058b025
processor.runtime_binding: require current-host engineering before data calls; preserve original CI and selected host receipts and runtime identity; verify stability after execution

question: Describe the fixed complete CALL and ASSISTANT pipelines versus raw microphone 0 on all 32 reserved full utterances, with near-only and synthetic doubletalk; no candidate selection or promotion.

renderer.doubletalk: full capture+render with clean-near and separate interference reference; no pure-echo ERLE claim
renderer.echo_mic0: existing echo_from_render of render; finite FIR taps above
renderer.echo_mic1: existing fractional_delay with physical_tdoa_samples(35,60); fixed linear interpolation, zero before source start
renderer.gain_rule: fixed 1/4 for every original in every scene/profile; no peak/RMS/outcome normalization
renderer.near_channels: same scaled near signal at both microphones
renderer.near_only: capture-only with no render; full default capture profile
renderer.padding: only synthetic lead/context/tail and final 0..159 zeros in new case; final original samples are never truncated
renderer.pair_rule: numeric adjacent speakers; same ordinal 0..3; both near/far orientations; no waveform-dependent selection
renderer.render_length_rule: when present, render sample count must equal microphone samples per channel before invocation; do not rely on CLI short-render padding
renderer.rounding: reuse existing scale/echo_from_render/fractional_delay PCM16 rounding; fail if any mix needs clipping
renderer.structural_overlap_definition: Per microphone, report potential echo support from complete far file/FIR/linear delay and its intersection with the unchanged original-near mask. This is not measured speech/VAD activity or continuous doubletalk. mic0=[320,F+1120), mic1=[321,F+1122).
